## Helus Pharma Appoints Michael Halstead as Chief Executive Officer
August 3, 2026

[PDF Version](https://ir.helus.com/node/11016/pdf)

NEW YORK and TORONTO, Aug. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Helus Pharma (Nasdaq: HELP) (Cboe CA: HELP) (the “Company” or “Helus Pharma”), a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company committed to helping minds heal by developing novel serotonergic agonists (“NSAs”), today announced the appointment of Michael Halstead as Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately.
